store.name: BenzStore
store.tagline: Unified Privacy-First AppStore for Android & PC
store.description: The independent, zero-telemetry application store for Jeremy Benz open-source software. Verified SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, native packaging, direct installation without JAR compilation overhead.
store.author: Jeremy Benz (@benzjeremy)

apps.name: BenzStore
apps.summary_de: Offizieller, einheitlicher AppStore für Android & PC mit One-Click Install & Version-Picker.
apps.summary_en: Official unified AppStore for Android & PC with one-click install & version picker.
apps.description_de: Der schlanke, datenschutzfreundliche AppStore von Jeremy Benz. Vollkommen frei von lästiger JAR-Signierung und Telemetrie. Unterstützt native Android-Installationen und automatisierte Linux/Windows-Paketverwaltung mit kryptografischer SHA-256-Integritätsprüfung.
apps.description_en: The sleek, privacy-first AppStore by Jeremy Benz. Completely free from JAR-signing bloat and telemetry. Supports native Android installations and automated Linux/Windows package management with cryptographic SHA-256 integrity verification.
apps.author: Jeremy Benz

versions.changelog_de: Initialer Release: Einheitlicher Android- & PC-AppStore mit SHA-256 Verifikation und Version-Picker.
versions.changelog_en: Initial release: Unified Android & PC AppStore with SHA-256 verification and version picker.

apps.name: Learn
apps.summary_de: Privacy-First Open-Source Programmier-Lern-App mit interaktivem Compiler-Labor.
apps.summary_en: Privacy-first open-source code learning app with interactive compiler lab.
apps.description_de: Didaktische Lernplattform für Go, Python, Webentwicklung, SQL, C# und PHP mit realistischem Compiler-Labor, fehlerspezifischem Feedback, 90-Minuten-Abschlussprüfungen und nativer Offline-Konformität (§ 5 DDG, DSGVO).
apps.description_en: Didactic learning platform for Go, Python, Web development, SQL, C# and PHP with realistic compiler lab, option-specific feedback, 90-minute final exam simulations, and native offline compliance.
apps.author: Jeremy Benz

versions.changelog_de: Native Offline-Rechtshinweise (§ 5 DDG, DSGVO) direkt in der App, Zero-Telemetry Härtung.
versions.changelog_en: Native offline legal notice (§ 5 DDG, GDPR) in-app, zero-telemetry hardening.

versions.changelog_de: 45 Lektionen in 9 Kursen, lokales Erinnerungssystem und didaktisches Feedback.
versions.changelog_en: 45 lessons across 9 courses, local reminder system and didactic feedback.

versions.changelog_de: Pure native Android UI (unter 1 MB), vollständiger Verzicht auf WebView-Overhead.
versions.changelog_en: Pure native Android UI (under 1 MB), zero WebView overhead.
Initial release of the learning application for Android.

apps.name: Wetter
apps.summary_de: Minimalistische Wetter- und Solar-PV-App mit Live-Homescreen-Widget.
apps.summary_en: Minimalist weather and solar PV forecast app with live homescreen widget.
apps.description_de: Werbefreie Wetter-App mit nativer Open-Meteo Direktanbindung (ohne API-Key, ohne Relay), 24-Stunden- und 7-Tage-Prognose, 5 kWp Solar-Ertragsprognose, interaktivem Startbildschirm-Widget und nativer Offline-Datenschutz-Transparenz.
apps.description_en: Ad-free weather app directly querying Open-Meteo (no API key or relay required), 24h & 7-day forecast, 5 kWp solar yield estimator, interactive widget and native privacy transparency.
apps.author: Jeremy Benz

versions.changelog_de: Native Offline-Rechtshinweise (§ 5 DDG, DSGVO), optimierte Widget-Aktualisierungslogik.
versions.changelog_en: Native offline legal notice (§ 5 DDG, GDPR), optimized widget refresh logic.

versions.changelog_de: Homescreen-Widget mit Live-Uhrzeit und konfigurierbarem Auto-Aktualisierungsintervall.
versions.changelog_en: Homescreen widget with live clock and configurable auto-refresh interval.
Initial release of the lightweight weather app.

apps.name: Untis-Go
apps.summary_de: Moderne, native Stundenplan-App für WebUntis – werbefrei, schnell & mit iCalendar Sync.
apps.summary_en: Modern native timetable app for WebUntis – ad-free, fast & with iCalendar sync.
apps.description_de: Schlanke, native Desktop- und CLI-Anwendung für WebUntis. Bietet bis zu 10x schnellere Ladezeiten als die offizielle App, iCalendar-Export (.ics), automatische Perioden-Erkennung, Offline-Caching und native WebKitGTK-Oberfläche.
apps.description_en: Lightweight native desktop and CLI application for WebUntis. Offers up to 10x faster loading than the official app, iCalendar export (.ics), automatic period detection, offline caching, and native WebKitGTK GUI.
apps.author: Jeremy Benz

versions.changelog_de: iCalendar Export (.ics), Perioden-Engine & Optimierung des lokalen Caches.
versions.changelog_en: iCalendar export (.ics), period engine & local cache optimizations.

versions.changelog_de: Datenschutz-Härtung, Entfernung von Microsoft-Logins, Zero-Telemetry Standard.
versions.changelog_en: Privacy hardening, removal of Microsoft login dependency, zero-telemetry standard.

apps.name: Docklite
apps.summary_de: Ultraschneller, ressourcenschonender Docker TUI & Desktop Container-Manager in Go.
apps.summary_en: Blazingly fast, lightweight Docker TUI & desktop container manager in Go.
apps.description_de: Kompakter Container-Manager mit interaktivem BubbleTea-Terminal, Live-Log-Streaming, Container-Metriken (CPU, RAM, Net IO), Volume-Inspektion und One-Click Lifecycle-Steuerung (Start, Stopp, Restart, Prune).
apps.description_en: Compact container manager with interactive BubbleTea terminal, real-time log streaming, live container metrics (CPU, RAM, Net IO), volume inspection and one-click lifecycle management.
apps.author: Jeremy Benz

versions.changelog_en: CI/CD pipeline optimization, improved terminal resize handling.

apps.name: Spotify Screensaver
apps.summary_de: Eleganter Vollbild-Bildschirmschoner mit Spotify MPRIS D-Bus Integration.
apps.summary_en: Elegant fullscreen screensaver with Spotify MPRIS D-Bus integration.
apps.description_de: Nativer Bildschirmschoner mit dynamischen Album-Artwork-Hintergründen, Liedtext-Visualisierung, MPRIS D-Bus Steuerung, intelligenter Werbeerkennung und ultra-niedriger CPU-Last unter Linux (WebKitGTK) und Windows.
apps.description_en: Native screensaver featuring dynamic blurred album art backgrounds, lyrics visualization, MPRIS D-Bus control, ad detection, and ultra-low CPU load on Linux (WebKitGTK) and Windows.
apps.author: Jeremy Benz

versions.changelog_de: Intelligente Werbeerkennung, automatischer Fokusmodus und optimierte WebKitGTK-Pipeline.
versions.changelog_en: Smart ad detection, auto focus mode, and optimized WebKitGTK rendering pipeline.
